recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-18377 unless a future work group decision changes extension context semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-18377 asked that the STU3 extensibility example use context type "element" rather than "fhirpath" because Patient is an element; the Jira resolution was to fix the example.
initial_application: The request was applied by ba9bc471bbb78fa776c278cded537db3bbb10621, which changed source/extensibility-examples.html from <type value="fhirpath"/> to <type value="element"/> in the target XML example.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini and source/hierarchy.xml show the extensibility examples page is in current build scope. Later FHIR-43364, already represented on the combined branch, clarifies that type=element can reference resource roots and that expression Patient is valid for a specific resource-root extension context.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current XML and JSON examples use type element with expression Patient, and a current-source search found no Patient context example still using type fhirpath.

related_jiras.note: R6 clarification confirms type=element with expression=Patient can specify a resource-root extension context; the issue is already represented on the combined branch and was used only as supporting context.
